name: Goddess Durga
shortDescription: The invincible Mother who protects dharma with fierce compassion.
description: Durga, the invincible one, is the Mother who rises to protect. In her many hands the gods placed their weapons — the trishula, the sword, the discus — and she holds them with the calm of compassion. Come to her for courage and for the reassurance of a mother's protection.

art.imageAlt: Trishula, khadga and chakra rising from a lotus
